ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given point $B$ is on line segment $AC$, and point $D$ is on line segment $AB$. If $AB=8\text{cm}$, $BC=6\text{cm}$, and $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$, what is the length of line segment $DB$ in $\text{cm}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in Figure 1:\\
$\because AB=8\text{cm}$, $BC=6\text{cm}$\\
$\therefore AC=AB+BC=8+6=14\text{cm}$\\
Furthermore, $\because D$ is the midpoint of segment $AC$\\
$\therefore DC=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times14=7\text{cm}$\\
$\therefore DB=DC-BC=7-6=\boxed{1\text{cm}}$;
